jobs.prompt:
Return `edits` (exact old text found once, and its replacement) using the anchors given; change nothing else. In docs/rented-gpu.md, in the section "## Bake-off: swarm gpu bakeoff", add a paragraph at the end of that section (use the next heading line "## Using the winner" as the anchor, add the paragraph just before it) titled in bold "The tasks" is not needed: write plain text: "Tasks. The 10 lane-benchmark tasks (two bug fixes, two new functions, two refactors, two test-writing tasks, two docs tasks; see bench/lane-benchmark/README.md) are scored by hidden tests, structural checks, mutants or fact checks. A hard task is added on top (bench/gpu-bakeoff/tasks/hard-planwaves): planWaves, a ticket wave planner. The model gets only TASK.md and a stub planWaves.mjs, never the tests or the solution; it is graded by running the 16 hidden tests (pass is 16 of 16), with 10 minutes per attempt. Per model and per best-of count the report records tests passed, time, attempts and tokens. Claude solved it in about 30 seconds, 16 of 16 on the first run (and Claude wrote the spec, so it had an advantage)." Also add one sentence at the end of that paragraph: "Known issue: Qwen3.6 NVFP4 crashes with a CUDA illegal memory access under vLLM 0.31.0 on the RTX PRO 6000 when started with --moe-backend flashinfer_b12x, so that flag is not used; vLLM's default MoE backend starts and serves."
